items.name: dev-sandbox-17
items.title: Possible compromise: CPU pinned + outbound traffic surge
items.why: CPU averages 98% since 16 Oct (was 2%), and network out is 10× its normal level. Miner-like pattern on a dev sandbox.
items.suggested_action: Isolate the VM, rotate its credentials and inspect running processes.

items.name: prod-worker-05
items.title: Level shift: CPU 4× its normal level for 48 h
items.why: Mean CPU over the last 48 h is 4.2× the prior 28 days. Excluded from sizing until understood.
items.suggested_action: Check recent deploys and queue depth with the owning team.

items.name: prod-web-31
items.title: Disk filling: about 3 days to 90%
items.suggested_action: Extend the volume or clean up logs before the ETA.

items.name: prod-api-32
items.title: Disk filling: about 7 days to 90%
items.suggested_action: Extend the volume or clean up logs before the ETA.

items.name: prod-search-33

items.suggested_action: Extend the volume or clean up logs before the ETA.

items.name: prod-checkout-34

items.name: vol-growing-10
items.title: Volume filling: about 1 days to 90%
items.why: Used space is rising 2.0 points/day (now 89%). Do not shrink it.
items.suggested_action: Extend before the ETA; cancel any shrink.

items.name: prod-reports-02
items.title: Unusual spike vs the same hours in other weeks
items.why: CPU held 95% for 8 h on 01 Oct; the same hours in other weeks sit near 14%.
items.suggested_action: Confirm whether this is a month-end job before the next one.

items.name: prod-api-04
items.title: CPU capacity: about 15 days to 90%
items.why: Daily CPU p95 is rising 1.38 points/day (now 69%). At this rate it reaches 90% around 04 Nov.
items.suggested_action: Plan an upsize or scale-out before the ETA.

items.name: prod-orders-08
items.title: Memory leak suspected (sawtooth)
items.why: Memory climbs from about 40% to 85% and resets 4 times in 30 days: a restart is hiding a leak.
items.suggested_action: Capture a heap dump before the next restart.

items.name: prod-search-02
items.title: Under-provisioned: CPU p99 at 100%
items.why: CPU p99 is 100% and p95 100%: requests are queueing at peak.

items.name: prod-nomon-13
items.title: Monitoring missing
items.why: Production VM with no metrics at all for 30 days: we can't tell whether it's safe.

items.title: Team cost jump: growth +13% in a day
items.why: growth spent ₹3,825 on 12 Oct vs a 7-day average of ₹3,393. New resources: dev-app-70, dev-app-71, dev-app-72, dev-app-73.
items.suggested_action: Confirm the new resources were planned.

items.title: Team cost jump: mobile +13% in a day
items.why: mobile spent ₹1,274 on 17 Oct vs a 7-day average of ₹1,129. New resources: dev-test-12.
items.suggested_action: Confirm the new resources were planned.

items.name: vm-ghost-99
items.title: Metrics for a machine not in the inventory
items.why: vm-9999 (vm-ghost-99) reports metrics but has no inventory row: possibly an unbilled or untracked machine.
items.suggested_action: Find the owner and add it to the inventory, or shut it down.
